headline: Delete monolithic agentic-upgrade guide, split into per-scenario guides
summary: The single draft agent-instruction doc is removed; its content is redistributed into shared.mdx, different-major.mdx, same-major.mdx and future-defaults.mdx added in the same PR. The CLI is updated to copy the new files instead of this one, so a line-by-line review of the deletion is unnecessary beyond confirming nothing still references it.
reason: Draft documentation file removed; its content lives on in the new split guides and next-upgrade.ts no longer references the old path.
